prompts.body: Create ONE production-ready base-body sprite asset for a modular 2D RPG equipment preview. The attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: classic hand-painted fantasy RPG, muted leather brown, moss green, warm parchment fabric, restrained shading, compact semi-realistic anatomy, small expressive face. New asset, not a copy of the reference character costume. Canvas square 1024x1024, genuine transparent background. Full body young adult male adventurer, tousled chestnut brown short hair, neutral friendly face, lean standard physique, three-quarter view facing toward screen-right and camera (SE), seen from slightly above. Height about 790 pixels, head top around y=110, soles around y=900; body centered around x=512. Modest fitted sleeveless sand-colored undershirt and dark short fitted undertrousers, bare forearms and bare feet. This is a clothed base mannequin, no nudity. Standing grounded with legs slightly apart, arms relaxed slightly away from torso, BOTH empty hands loosely clenched as if gripping equipment, right hand at screen-left around (350,560), left hand at screen-right around (650,540). All hands and feet clearly visible. No weapons, no shield, no belt, no boots, no cape, no accessories, no jewelry. Opaque painted body, transparent empty surroundings and gaps between limbs. Hand-painted sprite edges with delicate darker edge definition, visible broad material brushwork, upper-left soft warm light, no cast ground shadow. Clear silhouette at 168-pixel body height. Not pixel art, not photoreal, not glossy 3D, not chibi, not anime oversized head. No text or labels, no border, no extra views, no duplicate characters. Keep substantial empty margin around figure for equippable sprites.
prompts.traveler: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE TRANSPARENT CLOTHING OVERLAY asset fitted pixel-for-pixel to the attached base mannequin for a modular 2D RPG. Input image is the alignment template: preserve EXACT canvas dimensions, pose, body proportions, camera angle, silhouette placement, arm angles and leg spacing. Only paint the wearable clothing in its final worn position: moss-green short shoulder mantle and scarf collar (NO hood), warm ivory long sleeved linen shirt, fitted dark brown leather vest with straps and brass buckles, belt with one small pouch, dark charcoal-brown fitted trousers, worn brown leather knee boots. Classic restrained hand-painted fantasy adventurer matching the supplied base's painterly brushwork, thin dark edges, upper-left warm light; modest practical medieval costume, no large pauldrons. CRITICAL OUTPUT: clothing ONLY. NO person, NO skin, NO face, NO hair, NO head, NO hands, NO bare feet, NO mannequin, NO weapons. Where the head, neck opening and hands would be, leave truly TRANSPARENT holes. Sleeves must end at exactly the original wrists. Boots replace the original bare feet in the exact same foot positions. Keep the entire original canvas registration; do NOT center or zoom the costume independently. Empty background is genuine alpha transparency. No ground shadow, no labels, no decorative layout. The overlay will be drawn directly on top of the original image with identical coordinates, so registration is the most important constraint. One outfit only, not multiple views.

prompts.iron: Create ONE isolated 2D RPG weapon sprite on a genuinely transparent square canvas, matching the attached images' restrained hand-painted classic fantasy style. Subject: practical one-handed straight arming sword, weathered cool iron double-edged blade, narrow central fuller, simple dark steel crossguard, brown leather grip, modest round pommel. Entire sword VERTICAL with POMMEL AT TOP and sharp BLADE TIP POINTING DOWN. Handle centered horizontally, straight blade, no perspective tilt; subtle three-quarter bevel shading consistent with soft warm light from upper left. Grip clearly separate from guard. Full sword occupies about 78 percent of image height with generous margins. Crisp painted silhouette readable at game size, muted realistic materials, fine dark edges. No person, no hand, no sheath, no shield, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no second weapon. This is an equippable transparent object that will be anchored behind a character's hand.

prompts.shield: Create ONE isolated equippable shield sprite for a hand-painted classic fantasy 2D RPG, style matching the attached clothing. Round medium wooden adventurer shield, muted dark walnut planks, worn iron rim with small rivets, simple small steel central boss, one restrained faded moss-green painted band. Front face shown in shallow three-quarter perspective with right edge receding slightly, subtle ellipse, not a perfect flat UI icon. Soft warm upper-left highlights, restrained fine dark edges, hand-painted material brushwork readable when reduced to about 55 pixels tall. Entire shield centered on a genuinely transparent square canvas with generous empty margins. No character, no hand, no straps extending outside silhouette, no weapons, no glowing effects, no ground or cast shadow, no text or labels. One shield only.

normalization: Preserve full registration canvas; alpha values below 16 cleared as generation noise; uniformly resize to 768 square; WebP quality 95. Shared head/hands sampled from base body at runtime. Clothing is never resized by its opaque bounds.
